mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 0.25% in a 3-month window, it signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.25% in 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, sustained increases in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signal robust demand growth that supports corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of late-cycle periods with rising HOUST and RSAFS, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO increases over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 in a 3-month window, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO drops below 100 in 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates strong demand that boosts corporate sales, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST and RSAFS both rise, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 1.5%), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative policy that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with CPIAUCSL < 1.5% and declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.
